Recurrent ordinary strings are exactly compositions into runs of length >=2, and endpoint equality selects fixed versus primitive-two cycles. Geometric run-series count configurations with correct orbit multiplicity. The dominant simple pole at the golden-ratio reciprocal yields the exact 2/3 limit. Packaged exhaustive checker independently compares all n=3..16.

value.rationale: A canonical one-site contrarian perturbation of cyclic majority loses the symmetric-threshold hypothesis yet retains periods at most two; all genuine oscillation localizes to that one site. Exact orbit counts exhibit exponentially many primitive two-cycles and a 2/3 limiting periodic-state share, whereas homogeneous radius-one cyclic majority has only the two checkerboard states as a primitive two-cycle. This is a structural robustness and singular-defect distinction over every ring length, not a routine parameter substitution.
